_comment: Tier-2: LaplacianElement2D3N reads diffusivity NODALLY via ConvectionDiffusionSettings.GetDiffusionVariable() — the CONDUCTIVITY on the Properties object is IGNORED by this element. Pitfall (kratos.curved_mms #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). This is the curved_mms copy of the claim; the poisson-section copy has its own fixture (cda_conductivity_is_nodal). Measured here: CONDUCTIVITY, HEAT_FLUX, REACTION_FLUX and TEMPERATURE all resolve on core KratosMultiphysics and on NONE of them on ConvectionDiffusionApplication, and the settings object exposes SetDiffusionVariable / GetDiffusionVariable — the indirection that makes the Properties value unreachable. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
